output.what_they_do: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd is an Indian beauty and lifestyle destination operating online platforms, physical retail stores, owned consumer brands, and B2B distribution networks across beauty, fashion, and personal care segments.

segments.name: Beauty
segments.note: Includes online beauty platform, owned brands, retail stores, and B2B distribution.

segments.name: Fashion
segments.note: Includes fashion platforms and brand verticals.

drivers: Expanding omnichannel retail footprint and store formats across Indian cities.
Strategic partnerships with global iconic beauty brands and premiumisation trends.
Rising digital commerce adoption and growing base of financially independent consumers.

watch.text: Disputed direct tax matters under appeal for disallowances and tax computation provisions.
Disputed indirect tax claims including VAT demands, ITC disallowances, GST short payment, and misclassification.
Claims against the group pertaining to consumer cases.
M/s. S. R. Batliboi & Associates LLP serves as statutory auditor for material subsidiary Nykaa E-Retail Limited.
